title: Beyond Horizons
description: A lightweight Vanilla+ modpack focused on exploration, world generation, and smooth performance.
body:
Beyond Horizons enhances Minecraft while keeping the original Vanilla feeling intact. Built around exploration, atmosphere, and optimization, the pack transforms every world into a larger and more immersive adventure.

Powered by mods like Terralith, BetterEnd, YUNG's Better Dungeons, and When Dungeons Arise, the world feels more alive with massive landscapes, improved dimensions, new structures, and rewarding exploration.

At the same time, optimization mods such as Sodium help maintain smooth gameplay and high FPS even during heavy terrain generation.

Whether you're exploring giant mountain ranges, looting ancient dungeons, building peaceful bases, or surviving long-term worlds with friends, Beyond Horizons keeps Minecraft fresh without losing its Vanilla identity.

---

✨ Features

🏔️ World Generation Overhaul

* Massive terrain generation improvements
* Beautiful and immersive biomes
* Enhanced caves, mountains, rivers, and landscapes

🧭 Better Exploration

* More structures and dungeons
* Improved End dimension
* RPG-inspired adventure feeling
* More rewarding exploration

🌿 Vanilla+ Experience

* Keeps the original Minecraft progression
* Balanced gameplay
* Lightweight mod selection
* Enhanced survival experience without overwhelming mechanics

🚀 Optimized Performance

* Smooth gameplay and reduced stuttering
* Fast chunk loading
* Optimized for long-term survival worlds
* Multiplayer friendly

---

⚡ Performance

Tested on:

* AMD Ryzen 7 5700G
* Integrated Radeon Graphics
* 16GB RAM
* Resolution: 1600x900

Average performance:

* 200–260 FPS without shaders
* Smooth gameplay during exploration and terrain generation
* Stable performance with optimization mods enabled

---

❔ FAQ

*Is the modpack optimized?

Yes. Beyond Horizons is designed to deliver high performance while still improving world generation and exploration.

*Does it change Minecraft too much?

No. The goal is to enhance Vanilla Minecraft, not completely replace it.      

*Is it lightweight?

Yes. The pack focuses on optimization and balanced content instead of adding unnecessary complexity.

*Is it compatible with shaders?

Yes. Shader support works very well with the included optimization mods.

*Can I play it with friends?

Yes. The modpack is fully multiplayer friendly and works great on survival servers.

*What is the main focus of the pack?

Exploration, world generation, smooth performance, and a polished Vanilla+ experience.
